title: Typing in chat
description: Letters slide into place as you type. Editing in the middle of a line glides the rest aside, deleted letters fall away, pasted text is typed out letter by letter, and the message is sent as usual.

title: Commands keep their colours
description: A command typed with syntax highlighting and a Tab completion: every character animates in its highlight colour.

title: Appear and remove styles
description: Pop, Scramble, Wave and Drop, each cleared with a different remove style. There are 11 appear styles and 5 remove styles in total.

title: In the world
description: A pasted sentence typing itself out in the chat, one letter after another. The mod is client-side only.

title: Settings
description: The main options on one screen, with a live preview field and a Demo button that types a sample sentence for you (shown here mid-demo). A few advanced options live only in the config file.

title: Settings in Russian
description: The settings screen with the built-in Russian translation.

title: Options button
description: The settings are one click away in the vanilla Options screen. The button can be hidden.
